title: tunnel_auth_zephyr: native_sim run asserts on LICHEN_COAP_CLIENT default thread priority (prj.conf lacks LICHEN_COAP_CLIENT=n)
description: Running tunnel_auth_zephyr on native_sim/native/64 fails at boot: ASSERTION FAIL thread.c:517 (thread prio 15 == idle). Reproduced on clean main (no local changes) — pre-existing. Root cause: prj.conf does not set CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_CLIENT=n, so the client thread spawns at its default priority 15, which native_sim's 15-priority preempt range reserves for idle. Same known issue documented in tests/coap_keys/prj.conf ('No client thread in this test'). Fixture's testcase.yaml integration_platforms is qemu_x86 only, which is why CI never caught it; qemu_x86 run also failed on heft (run_qemu target error — possibly environment). Fix: add CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_CLIENT=n (and verify qemu_x86 run env) if native_sim support is desired; otherwise narrow platform_allow. Found while regression-running STANDALONE coap_server.c consumers for dsrv.
